title: Why Does One Volcano Ooze and Another Explode?
post_title: Why Does One Volcano Ooze and Another Explode? | QuantaTale
post_description: The surprising difference between gentle lava rivers and huge explosions. Sources: United States Geological Survey https://www.usgs.gov/faqs/how-do-volcanoes-erupt and National Aeronautics and Space Administration https://spaceplace.nasa.gov/volcanoes/en/ #Science #ScienceFacts #QuantaTale
narration: Why does one volcano gently ooze while another blows its top? Deep down, rock gets so hot that some of it melts into thick, flowing magma. Magma is lighter than the rock around it, so it rises. Thin, runny magma lets gas slip out, so it simply flows. Thick, sticky magma traps the gas, and pressure builds until boom. So Earth has both exploding volcanoes and slow rivers of lava.
